Hi Samir — great to hear from you and glad the Summit was useful.

We've got a lightweight program we call the Partner Enablement Studio: 6 weeks, cohort-based, with three core tracks — Technical (hands-on labs + PoC co-delivery), GTM (deal plays, value maps), and Enablement (sales/SE bootcamp + certification). Outcomes we routinely hit: one internal PoC, certified SEs with a Redwood badge, and a joint MQL playbook.

I'll attach the syllabus and a sample mutual action plan. High-level:
- Time commitment: ~8–12 hours per week across 6 weeks (mix of self-study, live labs, & two co-delivered sessions)
- Deliverables: PoC runbook, MLP (mutual lead plan), certification exam, 2 joint demo templates
- Pricing: discounted partner seat rates for training; revenue share for co-sold deals (we can outline tiers after we understand volume)

If that sounds good I can loop in our Partner Programs lead (Priyom Das) and the enablement lead (Laura Bennett) to draft an M.A.P. and propose start dates. Do you have a preferred cohort window in Nov/Dec?

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
